title: Date tile
brief: A tear-off calendar tile: red month band with two punch holes, a big day number, and a zigzag-edged RSVP strip below a perforation. The whole tile is a button that lifts on hover.

inspiration.note: Took the coloured month band with punch holes above a big day number; the zigzag tear-off strip with the perforation and the lift on hover are our own.
Took the pattern of a whole card acting as one button, with a visible keyboard focus ring offset from the edge.
